regions.today: Showers will become less frequent through the evening.
regions.tonight: Clear spells with well scattered showers tonight. Lowest temperatures of 5 to 9 degrees with west to southwest winds easing light to moderate.
regions.tomorrow: A mix of sunny spells and well scattered showers tomorrow morning. Through the afternoon and evening, rain will spread from the southwest as light to moderate southerly winds become southeasterly and increase moderate to fresh and gusty, stronger along southern coasts. Highest temperatures of 13 to 16 degrees.
